{{Quote|This could be a trap, Master. Are you sure you don't need us to go?''"<br />"''Of course its a trap, Skywalker.|Anakin Skywalker and Mace Windu|audio=OfCourseItsATrapSkywalker-ChildrenOfTheForce.flac|<ref name="Children of the Force" />}}
Following the [[Attempted kidnapping of Roo-Roo Page/Legends|capture]] of the infamous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the bounty hunter was interrogated, nearly [[Torture/Legends|tortured]], by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Bane eventually conceded and led [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to his base of operations, [[Black Stall Station/Legends|Black Stall Station]], in the [[Rogue Antar system/Legends|Rogue Antar system]]. The bounty hunter held the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] and [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], which contained a list of every [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] child in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], in the station, and promised the Jedi its safe return. Their '''mission''' to Black Stall Station was actually a trap laid out by Bane to ensure his own escape.

Upon entry to the station, Windu accidentally caused the security system to go off, and several laser cannons emerged from the station's walls. In the ensuing confusion, Bane escaped the station via an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] hidden behind an emergency hatch. Kenobi managed to retrieve the holocron and escape with Windu before the station's self destruct mechanism went off. Though Bane managed to escape, the holocron was safely retrieved with no indication that its contents had been duplicated.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|"You will take us to the holocron.''"<br />"''Jedi mind tricks don't work on me.''"<br />"''You will take us to the holocron.''"<br />"''Forget it.''"<br />"''You will take us to the holocron.''"<br />"''I... I won't.''"<br />"''And you will take us&hellip;''"<br />"''&hellip;NOW!''"<br />"''I&hellip; I will take you. No! Get out of my head!!"|Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Mace Windu using the Force on Bane's mind in unison|audio=CombinedMindTrick-CotF.flac|<ref name="Children of the Force" />}}
The ''de facto'' leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]&mdash;secretly Palpatine, the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;began relying on [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], who was considered to be the most efficient [[Bounty hunter/Legends|gun for hire]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Following his success in the Sith's assignment to steal both a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], a list of every known [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] child in the galaxy, from the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]], Bane was once again hired by Sidious to kidnap four of the children listed in the memory crystal and bring them to his facility on the volcanic mining world [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Bane succeeded in [[Mission to Glee Anselm/Legends|capturing]] the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Zinn Toa/Legends|Zinn Toa]] on the aquatic world [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]] and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], despite [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Second mission to Rodia/Legends|efforts]] to save the child. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] took the necessary precautions to save the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Roo-Roo Page/Legends|Roo-Roo Page]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], Bane's next target, leading Bane into a trap.<ref name="Children of the Force" />

After the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was captured on Naboo, he and his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the [[Xanadu Blood/Legends|''Xanadu Blood'']], were taken to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] ship [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]; the hunter was placed in a shielded holding cell, while his starfighter was examined by the Jedi. Interrogated by Jedi Masters Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], Bane refused to reveal the whereabouts of the kidnapped children and the location of a stolen Jedi [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]. The two Masters and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] bound together and [[Mind trick/Legends|employed]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the living force that binds all living creatures, to compel the strong-minded Bane to lead them to the stolen holocron. Thrashing from his attempts at resisting the Jedi's influence, Bane eventually promised to take them to the holocron, albeit with the intention of leading them into a trap. The bound bounty hunter was escorted into a waiting [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]], where he dictated the coordinates of the deep space [[Black Stall Station/Legends|Black Stall Station]], his base of operations, to his accompanying guards&mdash;Kenobi, Windu, and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], nicknamed "Cody." Though Anakin wanted to take part in the mission, he was instead ordered to report the Jedi's progress to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Children of the Force" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|Blast!''"<br />"''You certainly stepped in it this time.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], after the former steps into a booby trap|audio=SteppedInItThisTime-CotF.flac|<ref name="Children of the Force" />}}
After emerging in the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]&ndash;strewn system and docking to the outpost, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] left Cody with the ship and followed Bane into his base of operations. Though neither Jedi sensed the kidnapped infants, Bane told them that the children were "safe" and instead focused on the holocron. The Duros led them to the station's control room and pointed them to the holocron on a table across the room. Although Bane volunteered to get the holocron for them, Windu refused to let the bounty hunter perform another trick. However, Windu unintentionally activated the station's intruder alert system. With alarms blaring and a [[Laser/Legends|laser]] system targeting the Jedi, Bane sneaked away from the distracted Kenobi and Windu, while the two were occupied. Kenobi pursued the bounty hunter, but the Duros escaped through a concealed hatch. Breaking out of his binders, Bane fled Black Stall Station in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Meanwhile, Kenobi managed to retrieve the holocron and both Jedi Master managed to make their way back to the shuttle and depart just before the station exploded as a result of a self-destruct.<ref name="Children of the Force" />

==Aftermath==
Though Cad Bane managed to slip out of the facility during the skirmish, the holocron and Kyber crystal were retrieved. There were no signs that its contents, a list of every [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] child in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], were duplicated. While the two children Bane kidnapped were nowhere to be found in the station, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] traced Bane's fueling routes to the volcanic planet of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where they found the missing children and [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|rescued]] them from the hands of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="Children of the Force" />

==Behind the scenes==
This mission served as one of the four missions Cad Bane took, which first appeared in "[[Children of the Force]]," the third episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The episode aired on [[October 9]], [[2009]].<ref name="Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode203.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Children of the Force}}</ref> New technology introduced during production of [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|season two]] of ''The Clone Wars'' made it possible to fit Black Stall Station and several other locations depicted in "Children of the Force" into the timespan of a single episode.
